# GOG — edition, extras, and preservation update

- Original source: [GOG — edition, extras, and preservation update](https://www.gog.com/en/game/robin_hood)
- Author / publication: GOG / publisher-supplied description
- Language / date: English; preservation changelog 2025-04-25
- Access: Store page is JavaScript-only; data retrieved from the GOG product API
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09, via api.gog.com
- Archived copy: [Wayback Machine, 2026-09-05](http://web.archive.org/web/20260905092948/https://www.gog.com/en/game/robin_hood)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then the complete product data

GOG lists a Windows single-player release with offline installers. Included extras are a manual, soundtrack, artwork, avatars, and wallpapers.

The preservation changelog dated 25 April 2025 reports installer fixes, an added DirectX wrapper, and rendering options such as windowed display, V-Sync, gamma correction, integer scaling, and antialiasing. GOG also reports Windows 10/11 compatibility checks and cloud-save support.

The inspected language list includes English, German, Spanish, French, and Polish audio and text. The product description advertises over thirty missions and nine characters across infiltration, robbery, ambush, and castle-attack scenarios.

**Research use:** current edition differences and where owners can obtain the manual and soundtrack. These are GOG's product claims; compatibility was not independently tested. Prices and audience ratings are intentionally omitted because they fluctuate.

## Complete product data

The store page is a JavaScript application (the raw HTML carries only the title "Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood 50% off | GOG.COM" and the Preservation Program badge), so the product data was taken from GOG's public product API (`api.gog.com/products/1207659008?expand=description,changelog`) on 2026-09-09.

- Title Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood; slug `robin_hood`; product type game; not in development.
- GOG release date 2012-03-06; operating systems: Windows only (no macOS, no Linux).
- Languages: Deutsch, English, español, français, polski.
- Extras (from the GOG Database record): 15 artworks (13.6 MB), 2 avatars, 1 manual (6.3 MB), 1 soundtrack (26.2 MB), 3 wallpapers.

**Description (publisher copy, paraphrased).** England, 1190: Richard the Lionheart is a prisoner and Prince John rules the peasants by force; Robin Hood and a small band of followers take up the fight. The player roams Sherwood, confronts "royal trouble" and battles Prince John's forces with Little John and the Merry Men in what the copy calls a stealth-based real-time strategy game. Key features listed: a non-linear campaign with over 30 missions; mission types from robbery and infiltration to castle attack and ambush; action and adventure with stealth-tactical elements; an "innovative" combat system using mouse interaction for special combat skills; playable characters Robin Hood, Little John, Friar Tuck and Maid Marian among nine, each with specific abilities; graphics with day, night and fog; locations including Sherwood Forest, Nottingham Castle and York.

**Changelog dated 25 April 2025 (six entries, paraphrased):** GOG Galaxy installers fixed so the game installs on modern PCs; a DirectX wrapper applied; new rendering options added (windowed mode, V-Sync, gamma correction, integer scaling, anti-aliasing "and more"); stability validated; Windows 10 and 11 compatibility verified; cloud saves added. The GOG Database shows the matching build 58438832842632380 ("1.1 GOG v3") dated 2025-03-10 and offline installers relabelled "1.1 hotfix GOG v2" on 2025-04-25.
